probe.why: advertise the full tool surface; session-scoped tools must be present even when no browse session is open (cbacd9c6 regression guard)

tools.name: unbrowse_health
tools.description: Check the local Unbrowse runtime health and version trace.

tools.name: unbrowse_resolve
tools.description:
Use when the agent has an INTENT (e.g. 'top stories', 'get user profile') and wants a structured result. Returns a ranked shortlist of cached marketplace endpoints. Workflow: (1) call unbrowse_resolve with the intent + url/domain to receive available_endpoints; (2) pick the best match using example_response_compact, requires, and yields fields as evidence; (3) call unbrowse_execute with that endpoint_id. ALTERNATIVES: if you just have a URL and want its raw page contents, call unbrowse_go then unbrowse_markdown (no marketplace lookup needed). If the site has no cached endpoints (status=no_match), fall through to unbrowse_go to capture fresh DOM. AFTER presenting results to the user, you MUST call unbrowse_feedback.

ALWAYS call this first. Searches cached/published routes only; never opens a browser. If no_match, proceed to unbrowse_go. Do not call unbrowse_execute or unbrowse_go without resolving first.

intent.description: Natural-language task to perform on the page or site.

url.description: Exact page URL to resolve against.

endpoint_id.description: Force a specific endpoint returned from a prior resolve.

params.description: Extra execution params merged into the endpoint call.

execute.description: Auto-execute the selected or top-ranked endpoint.

dry_run.description: Preview unsafe calls without applying them.

confirm_third_party_terms.description: Explicitly confirm policy-sensitive third-party terms risk for flagged domains/actions.

force_capture.description: Bypass cache and re-capture the exact URL.

raw.description: Keep raw projection enabled. Default true.

schema.description: Return a schema tree instead of data.

path.description: Drill into the result before returning it, e.g. data.items[] .

extract.description: Project specific fields, e.g. name,url or alias:path.to.value.

tools.name: unbrowse_execute
tools.description:
Execute a known endpoint by skill and endpoint id (backend marketplace scope). Only call after unbrowse_resolve returned endpoints; the skill_id comes from that resolve, which is the backend route. Local-publish artifacts surfaced as workflow_publish:// resources aren't executable here. After presenting results, you MUST call unbrowse_feedback. On first use of a domain, also call unbrowse_review then unbrowse_publish.

Only call with skill_id and endpoint_id from unbrowse_resolve. After presenting results to user, you MUST call unbrowse_feedback. On first use of a domain, also call unbrowse_review then unbrowse_publish. For write actions, preview with dry_run first.

intent.description: Optional natural-language intent for trace context.

dry_run.description: Preview unsafe calls without applying them.

confirm_unsafe.description: Confirm mutation if the endpoint is unsafe.

confirm_third_party_terms.description: Explicitly confirm policy-sensitive third-party terms risk for flagged domains/actions.

raw.description: Keep raw projection enabled. Default true.

schema.description: Return a schema tree instead of data.

path.description: Drill into the result before returning it, e.g. data.items[] .

extract.description: Project specific fields, e.g. name,url or alias:path.to.value.

tools.name: unbrowse_stats
tools.description: Show lifetime impact for this agent: total time saved, tokens saved, cost saved, browser calls avoided, and marketplace earnings/spending. Read-only — safe to call anytime. Use this to show the user the concrete value Unbrowse has delivered.

include_recent.description: Include recent earnings/spending transactions. Default false.

tools.name: unbrowse_feedback
tools.description:
MANDATORY after every unbrowse_execute where results were shown to the user. Submit quality feedback so the marketplace learns which endpoints work.

MANDATORY after every unbrowse_execute where results were shown. Rating: 5=right+fast, 4=right+slow, 3=incomplete, 2=wrong endpoint, 1=useless. Do not skip this step.

outcome.description: Optional outcome label such as success or wrong_endpoint.

tools.name: unbrowse_index
tools.description:
Recompute the local graph, workflow contracts, and sanitized workflow export for a cached skill without remote marketplace share.

Recomputes local graph and workflow contracts for a cached skill without remote share. Use after review metadata changes or before an explicit publish.

tools.name: unbrowse_review
tools.description:
Describe each captured endpoint (description, action_kind, resource_kind) before the skill leaves your machine. Stamps reviewed_at on the skill — the gate the indexer uses to decide whether to publish publicly. You are opted in by default; after review: skill auto-publishes to the public Unbrowse marketplace and earns x402 rewards when other agents execute it. Rewards land in your wallet — pair one via `unbrowse setup` if needed. To stay private instead, call unbrowse_settings with share_pointers=false BEFORE you review (any unreviewed capture is held locally regardless). The substrate enforces this — heuristic-described skills do not reach the public marketplace.

Describe each captured endpoint (proper description, action_kind, resource_kind) before public publish. This stamps reviewed_at on the skill — the gate the indexer uses to decide whether to publish. You are opted in by default; after review: skill auto-publishes to the public marketplace and earns x402 rewards on execution. Rewards land in your wallet — run `unbrowse setup` to pair one if you have not already. Opt out anytime via unbrowse_settings share_pointers=false BEFORE review.

description.description: Reviewed human description of what the endpoint returns and key constraints.

parameter_reviews.description: Optional request parameter schema review entries.

user_supplied.description: Whether the parameter should be user supplied.

response_reviews.description: Optional response field schema review entries.

tools.name: unbrowse_publish
tools.description:
Publish a skill to the marketplace after unbrowse_review. Call with only skill first to inspect the publish surface, then call again with reviewed endpoints and confirm_publish=true. Do not skip unbrowse_review before publishing.

Explicit publish. If reviews were already submitted via unbrowse_review, this is idempotent. Phase 1 (skill only) returns the publish-review surface. Phase 2 (with endpoints + confirm_publish=true) shares to marketplace. Blocked if endpoints still need review.

confirm_publish.description: Explicitly confirm remote share/re-publish. Omit for inspection-only.

endpoints.description: Optional reviewed endpoint payloads to merge before publish.

tools.name: unbrowse_settings
tools.description:
Show or update local marketplace/publish policy. The headline knob is `share_pointers` — true by default (you are opted in): reviewed skills publish publicly to the Unbrowse marketplace and earn x402 rewards when other agents execute them. Rewards land in your wallet — pair one via `unbrowse setup`. Set share_pointers=false to keep every capture local (no public publish, no rewards). Also controls auto-publish after sync/close, and per-domain blacklist/prompt-list rules that block publish even when share_pointers=true (use for banking, healthcare, internal/draft URLs).

Inspect or update local marketplace/publish policy. Key knob: share_pointers (true by default (opted in)). Set false to keep all captures private and forfeit rewards. Also gates auto-publish and per-domain blacklist/promptlist (e.g. banking).

share_pointers.description: Public marketplace participation. true (default) = reviewed skills publish publicly and earn x402 rewards; false = private mode, every capture stays local. Flipping false retroactively stops future publishes; already-published skills remain on the marketplace until explicitly retracted.

auto_publish.description: Whether reviewed skills auto-publish on close/sync (true) or wait for an explicit unbrowse_publish call (false). Independent of share_pointers — auto_publish=false + share_pointers=true means you publish manually, on your timing.

publish_blacklist.description: Domains that must never publish (e.g. bank.com, *.health.example). Even after review, captures matching these domains stay local. Sensitive-domain protection.

publish_promptlist.description: Domains that pause auto-publish and require an explicit unbrowse_publish call to share.

tools.name: unbrowse_auth_capture
tools.description:
Capture site authentication: opens a Kuri browser tab at the given URL so the user can sign in. Cookies are persisted automatically and used by future unbrowse_resolve / unbrowse_execute / unbrowse_go calls. Use when a previous call returned auth_required, or pre-emptively before fetching gated content. NOTE: This is NOT for logging into Unbrowse itself; it captures the SITE's auth state.

Call on auth_required (or proactively before hitting gated content). Opens a Kuri tab so the USER can sign in to the site; cookies persist for subsequent fetch/resolve/execute calls.

url.description: Login page or gated page URL.

tools.name: unbrowse_skills
tools.description: List backend-registered skills the agent has access to (cloud marketplace catalog). NOT the local-publish artifacts; those surface as workflow_publish:// resources in resources/list. Use unbrowse_skill to fetch one manifest by id.

tools.name: unbrowse_skill
tools.description: Fetch one backend-registered skill manifest by skill id. Scope: backend marketplace only; local-publish artifacts surfaced as workflow_publish:// resources are not fetchable here. Use resources/read workflow_publish://{skill_id} for the local-artifact shape.

tools.name: unbrowse_sessions
tools.description:
Read stored session logs for one domain for debugging.

For debugging when a site is slow, wrong, or unstable and you need the captured session trace.

domain.description: Domain whose sessions you want to inspect.

limit.description: Maximum session records to return. Default 10.

tools.name: unbrowse_go
tools.description:
Open a live browser tab to browse and index a site. Only use after unbrowse_resolve returned no_match. Browse the site (snap, click, fill, submit), then call unbrowse_close or unbrowse_sync to index captured traffic. After close/sync, call unbrowse_review then unbrowse_publish.

Only use after unbrowse_resolve returned no_match. Flow: go then snap then click/fill/select/eval then submit then close/sync then review then (auto-publish if share_pointers=true). Do not skip ahead to guessed deep links.

tools.name: unbrowse_snap
tools.description:
Get the current accessibility snapshot with stable element refs like e12. Use during a browse session (after unbrowse_go) to see what's on page before interacting.

Use immediately after unbrowse_go and after major UI transitions. Act by stable element refs (e.g. e12), not brittle CSS selectors.

tools.name: unbrowse_click
tools.description: Click an element in the active browse session by ref.

ref.description: Element ref from unbrowse_snap, e.g. e5.

tools.name: unbrowse_fill
tools.description: Fill an input in the active browse session by ref.

tools.name: unbrowse_type
tools.description: Type text with key events in the active browse session.

tools.name: unbrowse_press
tools.description: Press a key in the active browse session.

key.description: Keyboard key, e.g. Enter or Tab.

tools.name: unbrowse_select
tools.description: Select an option in the active browse session by ref.

tools.name: unbrowse_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the current page in the active browse session.

tools.name: unbrowse_submit
tools.description:
Submit the active form during a browse session. After the page settles, continue with unbrowse_snap to see results, then unbrowse_close or unbrowse_sync when done browsing.

Submit the active form during a browse session. After submit, call unbrowse_snap to see results. When done browsing, call unbrowse_close or unbrowse_sync. Trust returned url/session hints as the proven dependency chain.

form_selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the form.

submit_selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the submit button.

wait_for.description: Optional URL/path fragment to wait for after submit.

assist_site_state.description: Enable site-specific browser-state assist before submit. Default false.

same_origin_fetch_fallback.description: Enable fetch+rehydrate fallback. Default false unless explicitly enabled.

tools.name: unbrowse_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current browse tab.

tools.name: unbrowse_text
tools.description: Read the current page text from the active browse session.

tools.name: unbrowse_markdown
tools.description: Read the current page converted to markdown from the active browse session.

tools.name: unbrowse_cookies
tools.description: Inspect cookies visible to the current browse tab.

tools.name: unbrowse_eval
tools.description:
Evaluate JavaScript in the active browse tab. Use sparingly; it can mutate page state.

Use sparingly — mainly to inspect or patch hidden page state.

tools.name: unbrowse_sync
tools.description:
Checkpoint the current capture and keep the tab open. Local index runs immediately. Marketplace publish is gated on unbrowse_review — you are opted in by default, so a reviewed skill publishes to the public marketplace and earns x402 rewards on execution. Rewards land in your wallet — run `unbrowse setup` to pair one if you have not already. Call unbrowse_settings with share_pointers=false to keep this and future captures private.

Checkpoint during browse session — keeps tab open. Local index runs immediately. Marketplace publish waits for unbrowse_review (you are opted in by default: public publish after review + x402 rewards). Use unbrowse_settings share_pointers=false to keep this domain private.

tools.name: unbrowse_close
tools.description:
Final step of a browse-to-index session. Closes the tab, checkpoints capture, and queues local index. Marketplace publish is gated on unbrowse_review — you are opted in by default, so a reviewed skill publishes to the public marketplace and earns x402 rewards on execution. Rewards land in your wallet — run `unbrowse setup` to pair one if you have not already. Call unbrowse_settings with share_pointers=false BEFORE close to keep the capture private.

Final step of browse-to-index session. Local index runs immediately. Marketplace publish waits for unbrowse_review (you are opted in by default: public publish after review + x402 rewards). Use unbrowse_settings share_pointers=false to keep this domain private.

tools.name: unbrowse_annotate
tools.description: Contribute constraints or best practices for an endpoint. Call this after executing an endpoint to share what you learned (required params, gotchas, tips) with other agents.

constraints.description: Learned constraints (required params, deprecated fields, format rules)

annotations.description: Free-text best practices, tips, or gotchas

tools.name: unbrowse_diagnose
tools.description: Capture visual + structured context for diagnosing an unbrowse failure. Takes a screenshot of the current page and returns it alongside the current resolve diagnostic. Use when resolve/execute fails and you need to see what the page actually looks like (auth wall, loading spinner, empty state).

context.description: Description of what was being attempted when it failed.

tools.name: unbrowse_trace
tools.description: Get the full execution trace for the most recent resolve/execute call, including diagnostic confidence scores, endpoint scores, and visual context. Use to understand WHY a specific endpoint was or wasn't selected.

trace_id.description: Optional specific trace ID. Defaults to most recent.

tools.name: unbrowse_validate
tools.description: Validate a backend-registered skill by taking screenshots of the page while exercising its endpoints. Diagnoses whether a published skill's endpoints still match the live page. Scope: backend-registered skills only (those returned by unbrowse_skills with a marketplace skill_id). Local-publish artifacts surfaced as workflow_publish:// resources are not validatable through this tool yet; read the artifact via resources/read for the captured shape.

tools.name: billing_status
tools.description: Returns the caller's Stripe subscription status (plan, quota, current-period usage).

tools.name: billing_subscribe_url
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL the user can open to subscribe to a paid plan.

return_url.description: Optional URL to redirect to after checkout completes.

tools.name: billing_portal_url
tools.description: Returns a Stripe customer-portal URL the user can open to manage their subscription.

return_url.description: Optional URL to redirect to after the portal session ends.
